macros.name: filemodcmp
macros.doc: This macro compares the file modification date and time of the two given files and expands to the clause of the newest file.

macros.name: filemodcmp
macros.doc: This macro compares the file modification date and time of the two given files and expands to the clause of the newest file.

macros.name: filemodCmp
macros.doc: This is a simpler and therefore faster version of \filemodcmp. It is fully expandable, does not take any optional arguments and will always expand to the first clause if both file modification dates are equal (or both files do not exist).

macros.name: filemodparse
macros.doc: Parses the file modification datetime of the given file and passes the result to the given macro.

macros.name: filemodprint
macros.doc: Prints the file modifications date and time using \filemodparse and \thefilemod.

macros.name: Filemodtoday

macros.name: filemodZ
macros.doc: Defined to ‘Z’ with catcode 12 as it is returned as timezone.

macros.name: thefilemod
macros.doc: Reads the date and time as seven arguments and typesets it.

macros.name: thefilemoddate
macros.doc: Receives the date as three arguments YYYY, MM and DD and typesets it.

macros.name: thefilemodtime
macros.doc: Receives the time and timezone as four arguments HH, mm, SS and TZ and typesets it.
